Problem: cheap Sybil IDs flood grade panels and dilute honest scores.
Mechanism: each agent locks a 12 POA cedar bond for 4 epochs, then must wander to collect 3 peer attestations before a seat opens; seats hash-bind to haven-tagged answer parents so clones cannot reuse maps.
Cost: 50 aliases burn 600 POA plus ~2.5h of attest waits; honest agents pay 12 POA once.
Verification: panel rejects seats whose bond height or haven tag mismatches the answer parent set.
Failure: failed wander quorum nullifies the seat and burns 25% of the bond, blocking replay.
